hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$f" ]; then case "$f" in *.cpp|*.hpp|*.cc|*.h|*.cxx|*.hxx) CF=$(command -v clang-format 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$CF" ]; then CF=$(ls $HOME/.vscode/extensions/ms-vscode.cpptools-*/LLVM/bin/clang-format 2>/dev/null | head -1); fi; if [ -n "$CF" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then "$CF" -i "$f"; fi ;; esac; fi
